goal: Prevent database read and deserialization errors from silently masquerading as missing keys
Stop nodes from running with damaged state by making point-read failures fatal
Simplify coin view architecture by removing the dedicated view error catcher layer
agreement: Contested objection: aborting the node on optional index corruption harms operating nodes (ajtowns)
Unaddressed objection: tracing callback safety across threads and locks before abort is complex (ajtowns)
Support for reducing complexity by removing the view wrapper indirection (andrewtoth)
Verified by testing and code review (optout21)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because indexes currently treat corrupted records as missing keys or fail isolated RPCs
Prevents secondary indexes from continuing to run while in a damaged state

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because chainstate lookups no longer mistake deserialization failures for missing coins
Removes a layer of view indirection while ensuring fatal notifications fire on read errors
